name: Rhizopogon vinicolor
notes: Long-distance exploration type [13]; treated together with R. vesiculosus. Reported (unchecked, Beiler 2010) to be the only species with a mapped tree-to-tree network in a real forest; spores are spread by small mammals.

tip_speed.note: Claude's inference from the species' ecology and general knowledge, not from a measurement (2026-11-10): forms long rhizomorphs between Douglas-fir trees; below the family default because cultures are slow

uptake_rate.note: tuning value, set to tip speed / segment length so that one feeding segment can supply about one growing tip; no measurement found
